The '''2023 Retro League Event 4''' was the fourth event of the [[2023 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]], played in [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]] format. It ran from 30 July to 10 September 2023.<ref name="t82166" /> 57 players registered, and [[Timo Dusel]] won.

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 30 July – 10 September 2023
* '''Players:''' 57 (in the posted standings)
* '''Winner:''' [[Timo Dusel]]
